title: [29.x]-Exporting vendor remittance gets stuck when a payment jour nal is sorted by Document No.
summary: Fixed an issue where exporting vendor remittance advice from a payment journal sorted by Document No. would hang indefinitely by ensuring lines are processed in primary key order instead of the current sort order.
key_points: Vendor remittance export now completes successfully when payment journal is sorted by Document No.
Solution uses SetCurrentKey to force processing by primary key (Journal Template Name, Journal Batch Name, Line No.) which doesn't change during export.
Prevents infinite loop caused by Document No. changes moving already-processed lines ahead in sort order.
Added regression test ExportPaymentJournalSortedByDocumentNo to prevent recurrence.
